|quest_reward4_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Flameblast''' is a [[channelled]] [[fire]] [[spell]] that builds up an explosion. Releasing or fully channelling the spell will create the explosion. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''Stages''': Flameblast deals more damage at each stage, starting from the first. This means it does 100% plus 165% base damage at the 1st stage, then 100% plus 2*165% with hits at the second stage, and so on, resulting in {{c|mod|1650% more Spell Damage}} modifier at the last stage, or 17.5x base damage with hits, and {{c|mod|600% more damage with ailments}} at the last stage, or 7x ailment damage. * '''[[Cast speed]]''': At base cast speed it takes 2 seconds to reach the maximum stage. Increasing the cast speed reduces the time to reach the next stage, similar to how {{il|Incinerate}} works. * '''[[Curse]]s''': The blast detonates ~0.5sec after releasing the key, giving the player enough time to cast a curse like {{il|Flammability}} or try to [[Shock]], however this will only boost the damage of burn if targets get ignited because the blast goes off before the curse or shock stacks.{{cite web|author=floytesangen & SlixMaru|date=December 23, 2013|title=[Discussion] Flameblast & Builds|url=http://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/1ti2es/discussion_flameblast_builds/|publisher=Reddit|accessdate=December 23, 2013}} Moving will set off the blast earlier. * '''[[Trap]]s, [[Mine]]s, and [[Trigger Gems|Triggers]]''': The skill can't be cast by conditional [[Trigger Gems|trigger gems]] such as {{il|Cast when Damage Taken}} and {{il|Cast On Critical Strike}}. It also can't be linked to {{il|Trap Support}} or {{il|Remote Mine Support}} unless also linked to a [[totem]].{{cite web|author=Pomfrod|date=December 23, 2013|title=[Discussion] Flameblast & Builds|url=http://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/1ti2es/discussion_flameblast_builds/ce8asla|publisher=Reddit|accessdate=December 23, 2013}} * '''[[Totems]]''': When linked to {{il|Spell Totem}}, the totem stops channelling automatically at max stacks. Letting the totem die or expire will also release the blast. * '''Notes''': Flameblast cannot be supported with {{il|Spell Cascade Support}} or {{il|Spell Echo Support}}. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Fire
Damage |c1_header = Deals x to y Fire Damage |c1_pattern_extract = Deals (%d+) to (%d+) Fire Damage |c1_pattern_value = %d to %d }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} {{Alternate skill effect list}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.29.0| * Flameblast: Now has +0.4 metres to radius per Stage (previously +0.3), and 120% Effectiveness of Added Damage at gem level 20 (previously 90%). Now deals 494 to 741 Fire Damage at gem level 20 (previously 405 to 608), and the base Mana Cost has been reduced by 20% at all gem levels. }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now provides +0-1 maximum Stages, instead of 0-20% increased Damage. }} {{Version history table row|3.17.0| * Flameblast now deals 31 to 46 Fire Damage at gem level 1 (unchanged), up to 405 to 608 at gem level 20 (previously 280 to 419). * Now deals 165% more Spell Damage for each stage (previously 130%). * Now has 90% Effectiveness of Added Damage at all gem levels (previously 60%). }} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * Flameblast now has 60% more Damage with Ailments for each Stage (previously 90%). Because of base Ignite damage changes, Ignite with the skill is now 75.0% higher at 10 Stages. }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Now has 130% more Spell Damage for Each Stage (previously 110%). }} {{Version history table row|3.13.0| * No longer has +5% chance to ignite for each stage. * Now has 50% chance to ignite at all gem levels. * Divergent Flameblast now grants 1% less cast speed per 1% gem quality (from 2% per 1% gem quality). }} {{Version history table row|3.12.4| * Fixed a bug where Divergent '''Flameblast''''s Less Cast Speed effect was not displayed. }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| * Now has alternative quality. }} {{Version history table row|3.10.0| * Now has a base radius of 2 (from 5). * Now gains +3 radius per stage (from +2). }} {{Version history table row|3.6.0| * Mana Cost at gem level 1 is now 4 (was 3). * Mana Cost at gem level 20 is now 7 (was 6). * Now deals 31 to 46 Fire damage at gem level 1 (from 32 to 48) and 280 to 419 Fire damage at gem level 20 (from 241 to 362). * Now has an added damage effectiveness of 60% (from 50%). }} {{Version history table row|3.3.0| * Now deals 90% more damage with ailments for each stage (up from 50%). * Now has +5% chance to ignite for each stage. * Now costs 3 mana at gem level 1 (down from 6), up to 6 mana at gem level 20 (down from 9). }} {{Version history table row|2.4.0c| * Improved Totem AI when used with Flameblast so that it ends the channel correctly once it has reached max stacks. }} {{Version history table row|2.4.0| * Added a [[channelled skill]] system. {{il|Incinerate}}, Flameblast and {{il|Wither}} are now channelled skills. * Unlike other skills, which are used once and quickly finish, when you use a channelled skill, it doesn't finish until you release the relevant button/key. You continue performing the same skill. * You need to pay [[mana]] repeatedly to keep the skill going. The channelled skill's mana cost must be paid again to maintain it with a frequency determined by the cast time. If you can't pay, the skill will end, just as if you'd lifted the button. * Dying, being [[stun]]ned, and other game mechanics that interrupt the use of skills will cause channelling to end as well. * Effects which [[trigger]] when you use a skill will only trigger when you initially start channelling - regardless of how long you maintain a channelled skill, it's still the same use of the skill. You need to stop channelling if you want to use it again. }} {{Version history table row|2.1.0| * Damage has been increased by around 20% at all levels. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * Now grants 1% increased damage per 1% quality (quality no longer affects ignite chance). * No longer works with Spell Echo. * Base Cast Speed has been increased from a cast time of 300ms to 200ms to compensate for no longer working with Spell Echo. }} {{Version history table row|1.3.1b| * Reduced the damage of Flameblast by 20%. }} {{Version history table row|1.2.0| * We have reduced the critical strike chance from 6% to 5%. We have reduced the damage by 15% at all levels. }} {{Version history table row|1.1.1| * Fixed a problem where Flameblast was accidentally buffed heavily in 1.1.0. Based on feedback on the insane version, we then buffed the pre-1.1.0 version by 48% on purpose in this patch. }} {{Version history table row|1.0.4| * Flameblast has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist|refs= {{cite web|author=LocalIdentity|date=June 6, 2025|title=Flameblast Calculations Issue|url=https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/issues/8614#issuecomment-2946867876}} }} {{Navbox Skills}} {{sister|poe2wiki}}
